raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Delivery batch 14 (ingested 2026-01-19) sends customer_id in lowercase ('c00138' instead of 'C00138'), which is why customer_id has 361 distinct values against 200 customers. The case-sensitive join to silver_customers therefore drops about 318 POSTED rows from gold_region_daily, and the same casing splits customers in gold_customer_spend.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, upper(trim(customer_id)) AS customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'", "silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT upper(trim(customer_id)) AS customer_id, upper(region) AS region FROM raw_customers"}}
